Ice axe, right hand, from the CEO's reference: held frame (N14 / N4 round 3b)

F4 arsenal - tools/art/hand_ref.py - drafts in work/art/hand_ref/ · 2026-10-14 23:54

N14 / N4 round 3b: the ice axe's held frame (ready), the hand derived from the CEO's reference image 1, now as a right hand (the file is mirrored on purpose; flipped back before the cut-out, so the arm comes in from the bottom right like Doom's fist and chainsaw and our TT-33 hands): segmented from the photo, turned and scaled to the TT-33 hands' scale, toned onto the same skin and sleeve ramps (palette v2 flesh_pink, military_green). Polished after the PM's notes: the haft is toned as wood (shadow side, body, lit side, grain, a dark rim; darker inside the fist) instead of a flat pale ruler, and the head has weight (a deeper pick, a wider and thicker adze, a dark rim) so it reads as the D40 ice axe at 1x, not a sickle. Every frame stands as high as the TT-33 (56 px above the bar, D57). Round 3a (left-handed, 2026-10-14_2252) stays as it was. Pick a cell, or none; the swing frames follow from the chosen one. Nothing here is installed.

What was taken from the reference

The CEO's Fooocus image 1, mirrored back to a right hand, dimmed outside what was kept: hand and sleeve as segmented (sleeve tinted green), the photo's shaft cut out (blue; ours goes in its place), the rough lasso (yellow) and the knuckle span that sets the scale (red). The photo's own axes and knives are not used.

R1 hand grabbing mirrored.png
right hand round the haft, thumb over the fingers (CEO's best)

Cells that pass the self-gate

Each: the frame alone at 3x; on a MAP01 mock with our status bar at 1x and 2x, next to the approved TT-33 ready frame (SDTTA0, D61) on the same mock; and the hands region at 4x, ours against the TT-33's.

C1 · the base: R1 as a right hand, 4 skin tones, the TT-33's hand scale, centre-right

PASS: A right hand from the player's eye: the sleeve comes in from the bottom right, the back of the hand faces right, the thumb closes over the top of the haft and the four knuckles curl round it on the left, towards the centre. The haft is wood now (rust shadow side, khaki body, cream lit side, a dashed grain, a dark rim), darker inside the fist, showing under the head and below the fist; the head has weight (deeper pick, wider and thicker adze, a dark rim) and reads as the D40 ice axe, not a sickle. Same top as the TT-33; about 920 skin px above the bar against its 999. At 1x the fingers are a knuckle row; at 2x, fingers.
